records.rawDisplayText: Create a new folder called "ΕΠΛ111 Μαθηματικός Συλλογισμός". Then consult [[ΕΠΛ111 Material/Μαθηματικός Συλλογισμός (Mathematical Reasoning).pdf|Μαθηματικός Συλλογισμός (Mathematical Reasoning).pdf]]  and create notes on it within the new folder you just created. Include a syllabus and number the different notes in the intended reading order. Explain the thought process behind each example. When applicable and fitting include tips and tricks. The end result should be a syllabus and several numbered notes with the correct reading order. Keep it well structured and intentional with it's explanations.
